Glutathione Evidence & Sources

Every study this page relies on, with its published title, our reading of it and a link to the source. Graded A controlled human trial measured by instrument · C human skin samples · Review a summary of other work.

StudyGradeWhat it found

Skin-whitening and skin-condition-improving effects of topical oxidized glutathione: a double-blind and placebo-controlled clinical trial in healthy women

Watanabe F, Hashizume E, Chan GP, Kamimura A, 2014 · Clin Cosmet Investig Dermatol · 7:267–274

View on PubMed →		A30 women aged 30–50, 10 weeks, randomised, double-blind, split-face. Skin pigment −10.7% against −3.1% on placebo (p < 0.001); 77% against 23% saw brighter-looking skin; crow's feet visibly softer in 1 in 3 women against none; smoother and better-moisturised by instrument. Run by Kyowa Hakko Bio, the GSSG manufacturer.

Combination of topical and oral glutathione as a skin-whitening agent: a double-blind randomized controlled clinical trial

Wahab S, Anwar AI, Zainuddin AN, Hutabarat EN, Anwar AA, Kurniadi I, 2021 · Int J Dermatol · 60(8):1013–1018

View on PubMed →		AA serum with 2% glutathione and vitamin C lowered skin pigment 10.8% in 8 weeks against a placebo serum on the other cheek (p = 0.029), and brightened the colour-meter reading (p = 0.046). No reactions in 46 women. Independent: no funding, no conflicts of interest.

The clinical effect of glutathione on skin color and other related skin conditions: A systematic review

Dilokthornsakul W, Dhippayom T, Dilokthornsakul P, 2019 · J Cosmet Dermatol · 18(3):728–737

View on PubMed →		ReviewAn academic systematic review: topical 2% oxidised glutathione "could brighten skin color in sun-exposed area".

Systematic Review of the Efficacy and Safety of Topical Glutathione in Dermatology

Khanna R, Rambhia P, Chapas A, 2025 · J Clin Aesthet Dermatol · 18(9):51–54

View on PubMed →		ReviewA review of five topical trials: topical glutathione "shows promise for dermatological applications". No conflicts of interest declared.

Aging- and photoaging-dependent changes of enzymic and nonenzymic antioxidants in the epidermis and dermis of human skin in vivo

Rhie G et al., 2001 · J Invest Dermatol · 117(5):1212–1217

View on PubMed →		CGlutathione was lower in naturally aged and sun-aged human skin than in young skin.

Published titles are quoted exactly as they appear in the journal.

Glutathion : données & sources

Chaque étude sur laquelle s'appuie cette page, avec son titre publié, notre lecture et un lien vers la source. Évaluation : A essai contrôlé chez l'humain, mesuré par instrument · C échantillons de peau humaine · Revue une synthèse d'autres travaux.

ÉtudeÉvaluationCe qu'elle a trouvé

Skin-whitening and skin-condition-improving effects of topical oxidized glutathione: a double-blind and placebo-controlled clinical trial in healthy women

Watanabe F, Hashizume E, Chan GP, Kamimura A, 2014 · Clin Cosmet Investig Dermatol · 7:267–274

Voir sur PubMed →		A30 femmes de 30–50 ans, 10 semaines, randomisé, double aveugle, demi-visage. Pigment de la peau −10,7 % contre −3,1 % sous placebo (p < 0,001) ; 77 % contre 23 % ont vu une peau d'apparence plus lumineuse ; pattes-d'oie visiblement adoucies chez 1 femme sur 3, contre aucune sous placebo ; peau plus lisse et mieux hydratée selon les instruments. Mené par Kyowa Hakko Bio, le fabricant du GSSG.

Combination of topical and oral glutathione as a skin-whitening agent: a double-blind randomized controlled clinical trial

Wahab S, Anwar AI, Zainuddin AN, Hutabarat EN, Anwar AA, Kurniadi I, 2021 · Int J Dermatol · 60(8):1013–1018

Voir sur PubMed →		AUn sérum contenant 2 % de glutathion et de la vitamine C a réduit le pigment de la peau de 10,8 % en 8 semaines par rapport à un sérum placebo sur l'autre joue (p = 0,029), et a augmenté la luminosité mesurée au colorimètre (p = 0,046). Aucune réaction chez 46 femmes. Indépendant : aucun financement, aucun conflit d'intérêts.

The clinical effect of glutathione on skin color and other related skin conditions: A systematic review

Dilokthornsakul W, Dhippayom T, Dilokthornsakul P, 2019 · J Cosmet Dermatol · 18(3):728–737

Voir sur PubMed →		RevueUne revue systématique universitaire : le glutathion oxydé à 2 % en application cutanée « pourrait rendre la couleur de la peau plus lumineuse dans les zones exposées au soleil ».

Systematic Review of the Efficacy and Safety of Topical Glutathione in Dermatology

Khanna R, Rambhia P, Chapas A, 2025 · J Clin Aesthet Dermatol · 18(9):51–54

Voir sur PubMed →		RevueUne revue de cinq essais cutanés : le glutathion en application cutanée « est prometteur pour des applications dermatologiques ». Aucun conflit d'intérêts déclaré.

Aging- and photoaging-dependent changes of enzymic and nonenzymic antioxidants in the epidermis and dermis of human skin in vivo

Rhie G et al., 2001 · J Invest Dermatol · 117(5):1212–1217

Voir sur PubMed →		CLe taux de glutathion était plus bas dans la peau humaine vieillie naturellement et dans celle vieillie par le soleil que dans la peau jeune.

Watanabe F, Hashizume E, Chan GP, Kamimura A, 2014 · Clin Cosmet Investig Dermatol · 7:267–274

Vedi su PubMed →		A30 donne di 30–50 anni, 10 settimane, randomizzato, doppio cieco, mezzo viso. Pigmento della pelle −10,7% contro −3,1% con placebo (p < 0,001); il 77% contro il 23% ha visto una pelle dall'aspetto più luminoso; zampe di gallina visibilmente più morbide in 1 donna su 3, contro nessuna con placebo; più liscia e meglio idratata secondo gli strumenti. Condotto da Kyowa Hakko Bio, il produttore del GSSG.

Combination of topical and oral glutathione as a skin-whitening agent: a double-blind randomized controlled clinical trial

Wahab S, Anwar AI, Zainuddin AN, Hutabarat EN, Anwar AA, Kurniadi I, 2021 · Int J Dermatol · 60(8):1013–1018

Vedi su PubMed →		AUn siero con il 2% di glutatione e vitamina C ha ridotto il pigmento della pelle del 10,8% in 8 settimane rispetto a un siero placebo sull'altra guancia (p = 0,029), e ha aumentato la luminosità misurata dal colorimetro (p = 0,046). Nessuna reazione in 46 donne. Indipendente: nessun finanziamento, nessun conflitto di interesse.
